passes.name: doc-audit
passes.what: Docs, rules, skills and references re-verified against the code so stale guidance stops steering sessions

passes.name: memory-prune
passes.what: Auto-memory entries promoted into rules/skills/docs or deleted so the machine-local store stays small and non-duplicative

passes.name: economy-pass
passes.what: Always-loaded rules, CURRENT.md and skill bodies cut by the four-question test so per-session context cost stops regrowing

passes.name: session-mining
passes.what: Recurring friction mined from session logs and converted into rules, skills or hooks

passes.name: arch-audit
passes.what: Service boundaries, package health, suppressions, dead code, duplication and coverage re-measured

passes.name: usage-audit
passes.what: Weighted token spend measured against plan capacity so the delegation posture stays calibrated

passes.name: ratchet-tighten
passes.what: Every ratchet re-measured and slack baselines tightened down so gates stop tolerating silent regrowth
